newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay inflation rose 1.58 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay inflation rose 1.58 pct in October.

text.p: Uruguayan consumer prices rose 1.58 percent in October, down from a 2.50 percent increase in September but up from 1.51 percent in October 1995, the National Statistics Institute said Tuesday.
October's inflation brought to 21.40 percent the increase in the first 10 months of 1996, against 30.04 in the same period last year.
In the 12 months to October consumer prices rose 26.40 percent, below the 39.51 percent in the previous year, the institute said.
Uruguayan inflation was 35.4 percent in 1995. It expects inflation this year to be 25 percent.
